description: Order and orient contigs into scaffolds from paired-end links with the greedy path-merging rule (Huson, Reinert & Myers 2002): links in descending weight, a link used only if both contig ends it joins are free and it closes no cycle. Positive gapSize -> that many gapCharacter; negative gapSize -> the -gapSize overlap is collapsed when its bases agree (N matches anything), else (and for 0) the AGP unknown gap of 100.

links.description: Links {contig1, contig2, gapSize, contig1Reversed?, contig2Reversed?, weight?}: contig2 follows contig1 (each reverse-complemented when its flag is set) after gapSize characters (negative = overlap); weight >= 1 (default 1).

unknownGapLength.description: Number of gap characters for a gap of unknown size (zero estimate, or a negative estimate whose overlap is not found); >= 1, default 100 (NCBI AGP v2.1); 1 = the single n of ABySS/SSPACE.

scaffolds.description: The assembled scaffolds, one string per scaffold.

errors.message: gapCharacter must be exactly one character
